question: Should siddha and others be purified in woman-given or dream-obtained cases?
premises: in woman-given cases do not purify
in dream-obtained cases do not purify
siddha and others are not purified at all
inference: Siddha and others should not be purified at all in woman-given or dream-obtained cases.
plain_english: Do not purify siddha and others at all in woman-given or dream-obtained cases.
